descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S25 「dashboard 开着时断网：一条清楚的「no network」提示，然后计数不刷新就追上」 Network drops with the dashboard open: a clear no-network message, then the counts catch up without a reload

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 When a TC-20 action fails, the screens say so instead of looking current. If note generation fails (main and backup model), the chart shows 'Note not generated' with the dictation kept and the dashbo …（UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5；UAT OAT-03）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture. Dashboard open in context A; a second client (context B) on the same account

When Take context A offline (context.setOffline(true); if that does not drop the Convex WebSocket, close it with page.routeWebSocket). From B, move the patient from pending to pre-rounded. Wait 10 s, then bring A back online. Both care settings

Then While offline, A shows a clear 'no network' message, or at least does not present its counts as current. After reconnect, A's counts and row catch up to B's write without a reload

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT Empty & Failure States ('Offline / no network: clear "no network" message'), OAT-03. Offline checkpoint: 'no network' shown (UAT wording, matched case-insensitively). Reconnect checkpoint: Pending 0, In Progress 1 within the step's expect timeout (Q8 gives no limit), with no reload in A

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S25

Network drops with the dashboard open: a clear no-network message, then the counts catch up without a reload

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane newspec-c：newspec-c/results.json 里 status passed → 通过（通过）。

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec per care setting: fresh account, one pending patient / In Today resident. Context A on the dashboard goes offline (context.setOffline(true)); first check the Convex socket really dropped. Context B types the pre-round text and Save Note (parse answered at B's socket so the status change is deterministic; B is online). After 10 s A must show the 'no network' banner and A's counts must not have moved. A back online: counts catch up (Pending 0, In Progress 1) without a reload. — setOffline + a second context; the banner and counters are DOM reads.

Detail:

Both care settings pass (rounding 4 runs, snf 5 runs; failures seen only from backend overload or a dev-server page reload, both fixed/excluded). A offline (setOffline + Convex socket cut; setOffline alone did not close the open socket): banner 'No network connection. What you dictate stays on this screen…', counts held at Pending 1; B's pre-round Save Note moved the chart; after reconnect A shows Pending 0 / In Progress 1 within 0.1-3.8 s, no reload, banner gone.

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: the step to write is a scripted Playwright spec in tools/qa-agent that makes its own fresh accounts and takes one of two contexts offline (fault-offline); dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action or socket mock (runner-contract §10), so it runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
